name: Sejal Glass Ltd
title: Sejal Glass Ltd - 532993 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin 17.5% and FY26 PAT INR 29.03 cr, but India utilisation is low (tempering 13-64%) and management guides UAE growth ~20% with FY27 India ~INR 200 cr, a plan that depends on Glasstech ramp-up.

utilisation.quote: the tempering capacity utilization is around 64%., our IG is 30% and lamination is 87%

capex.quote: we had already ordered some machines which are yet to be installed. Because of this geopolitical, it was delayed by one quarter

triggers.label: Silvassa tempering utilisation 64%, target ~75%
triggers.quote: the tempering capacity, more or less it will be in the range of 75%

triggers.label: UAE machines ordered, install Q2/Q3
triggers.quote: we are expecting that in Q2 or Q3, we will be installing these machines and it will start producing

triggers.label: Glass prices up 7-8% on energy surcharge
triggers.quote: there is an increase of around 8% in the glass prices because of the energy cost

triggers.label: Glasstech EBITDA breakeven reached
triggers.quote: in the last month, we are at EBITDA breakeven

guidance.quote: For FY27, we are considering total overall (500+) crores
we are expecting around 200 crores from India over a year ‘26-27
we will maintain around 17.5% to 18% EBITDA
we are going to close around 31 million (AED)
This quarter, we are expecting at least 10% EBITDA positive

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY27 EBITDA margin ~18% (from prior call, per analyst)
prior_guidance_check.quote: we will maintain around 17.5% to 18% EBITDA

red_flags.label: UAE geopolitical slowdown and supply chain disruption
red_flags.quote: there is a little bit slowdown in the real esta te

red_flags.label: India plants at low utilisation; Glasstech negative margin
red_flags.quote: Glasstech units have given a negative margin

red_flags.label: Management says India revenue FY26 ~63 cr standalone vs proforma decline questioned
red_flags.quote: Without Glasstech, we did only 63 crores

evasions.topic: Glasstech FY26 proforma revenue vs prior year
evasions.quote: No, it was not there. Glasstech came only in May and June.
